The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatiotemporel dynamics of within-host bacterial infections are complex, stochastic, and highly variable.
bacterial death and replication rates are not constant during the course of an infection and that these rates are not uniform across the host, leading to a highly heterogeneous bacterial population.
